content: Hello! How can I help you with your account today?
Hi, I’m having trouble accessing the secure portal. I forgot my password.
No problem! Let’s get you back in. Could you please provide your company email address so I can send you a reset link?
Thanks, John. I’ve sent a password reset email to jsmith@company.com. Please check your inbox and click the link inside.
I see the email. Clicking the link now.
Great. You should be prompted to enter a new password. Please choose one that meets our security guidelines.
Done. I’ve set a new password.
Perfect! Try logging in with your username and the new password. Let me know if it works.
It worked. I’m in! Thanks for your help.
